liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Jack Straw** (2 reviews): Blazing opener followed by a bouncy They Love Each Other; Listener calls it possibly the best Jack Straw they have ever heard [25][27]
- **Mexicali Blues** (1 review): Listener experiences an epiphany while listening to Mexicali Blues [29]
- **DuPree's Diamond Blues** (1 review): Features a great Garcia solo during the performance [32]
- **C.C. Rider** (1 review): Bob kills the slide guitar solo while the band swings [32]
- **Lazy Lightnin'** (1 review): The jam is described as electric, delicate, and raunchy [34]
- **China Cat Sunflower** (1 review): Listener prefers the piano sound over keys for this song [31]
- **I Know You Rider** (1 review): Brent's organ sounds like subway wheels before Bob's train horn slide [33]
- **Black Peter** (1 review): Needs thirty more seconds of Jerry's vocals to be an all-time version [30]

## The recordings

- **gd1983-10-18.aud.morris.111057.sbeok.flac24** (recommended): audience recording; 21 songs; 161 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [1]
- **gd1983-10-18.aud.carpenter.andrewf.87180.flac16**: audience recording; 21 songs; 162 min [2]
- **gd83-10-18.aud.dodd.12484.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 21 songs; 160 min; rated 4.58/5 by 12 [10]. Said about its sound: Excellent recording with significant crowd noise and good band sound; Brent's keys keep things friendly and bouncy sounding [25][28]
- **gd1983-10-18.164041.senn421.vita.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 21 songs; 160 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [11]
- **gd1983-10-18.143309.beyerm201.holbrook.flac2448**: audience recording; 21 songs; 159 min [15]. Said about its sound: Distortion and channel dropouts occur about ten minutes into the recording [15]

## Around the show

- The band made two trips to Maine in 1983 [25]
- Cumberland County Civic Center described as a magic spot with great shows [28]
- Maine received a double dose of Lazy Lightning to Supplication in 1983 [34]
- Tape flip occurred between Drums and Space [1]
- A Throwing Stones hint appears after Not Fade Away [2]
- First set rivals many Hot First Sets and the night before [30]
- Eaton pull has more warmth and bass than the Dodd upload [36]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1983-10-18.aud.morris.111057.sbeok.flac24**: taped by Bob Morris; source: (FOB) Nakamichi CM-300 (CP-1) x2 > Cassette Master (Sony TCD5M/Maxell UDXLII C-90); Cassette Master (Nakamichi DR-1) > Korg MR-1000 (1-bit/5.6MHz) > Audiogate… [1]. Also: Recorded FOB center by Bob Morris; transferred and converted by him [1]
- **gd1983-10-18.aud.carpenter.andrewf.87180.flac16**: taped by Ted Carpenter (Set 1) and Unknown (Set 2); transferred by Andrew F.; source: Set 1 Source: Sennheiser MD-421's > patched thru one deck > Marantz PMD-360 > Maxell XL-II, with no Dolby. Mics on stand, set up FOB; Set 2 Source: First-gen… [2]. Also: Ted's second set tape was unusable, so a replacement was secured [2]
- **gd83-10-18.aud.dodd.12484.sbeok.shnf**: source: FOB-AUD> MC> CDR [10]
- **gd1983-10-18.164041.senn421.vita.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Jim Vita; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Jim Vita's Master (FOB) Audience Cassettes; Sennheiser 421 mics > Jim Vita's 1st generation cassettes [11]. Also: Jim Wise supplied Sennheiser 421 source for crowd and Althea notes [11]
- **gd1983-10-18.143309.beyerm201.holbrook.flac2448**: taped by Executive Crew Kyle Holbrook Tom Pinney Chris Kidwell Sean Murtha Mike Yacavone Olvy Johnson; transferred by Kyle Holbrook; source: Master AUD/MC Beyer M201's X-Y 7'up > Sony TCD5M no dolby Konica Metal90 x 2 Location: 40 feet from stage, DFC [15]

claims.text: Blazing opener followed by a bouncy They Love Each Other
Excellent recording with significant crowd noise and good band sound
The band made two trips to Maine in 1983
Listener calls it possibly the best Jack Straw they have ever heard
Cumberland County Civic Center described as a magic spot with great shows
Brent's keys keep things friendly and bouncy sounding
Listener experiences an epiphany while listening to Mexicali Blues
First set rivals many Hot First Sets and the night before
Needs thirty more seconds of Jerry's vocals to be an all-time version
Listener prefers the piano sound over keys for this song
Features a great Garcia solo during the performance
Bob kills the slide guitar solo while the band swings
Brent's organ sounds like subway wheels before Bob's train horn slide
Maine received a double dose of Lazy Lightning to Supplication in 1983
The jam is described as electric, delicate, and raunchy
Eaton pull has more warmth and bass than the Dodd upload
Recorded FOB center by Bob Morris; transferred and converted by him
Tape flip occurred between Drums and Space
Ted's second set tape was unusable, so a replacement was secured
A Throwing Stones hint appears after Not Fade Away
Jim Vita provided first generation cassettes; Charlie Miller handled the transfer
Jim Wise supplied Sennheiser 421 source for crowd and Althea notes
Distortion and channel dropouts occur about ten minutes into the recording
